scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.check: npm run check:runtime && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.build: npm run check:runtime && npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @visual-form-builder/api && npm run build --workspace @visual-form-builder/web
scripts.test:readiness: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @visual-form-builder/api && node --test tests/readiness.test.mjs
scripts.test:transactions: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @visual-form-builder/api && node --test tests/transactions.test.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings=0 && oxlint --deny-warnings apps packages tests vitest.config.ts vitest.database.config.ts
scripts.test:db: npm run build:packages && vitest run --config vitest.database.config.ts
